meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Use Orca orchestration for structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply flows, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, or decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` instead for full ownership handoffs, including requests phrased as "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", or "another worktree" when the user did not explicitly ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG. Use `orca-cli` for ordinary terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, reading or waiting on terminals, and automation of the browser embedded inside Orca. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体分工协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把一个大任务拆成多个助手并行处理并汇总结果。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple AI agents to split and execute complex tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple AI assistants and need structured task coordination.

howto.what: 让 Claude 在需要结构化多智能体协调（如任务分发、DAG、决策门）时，先解析 ORCA 命令并运行 orca skills get orchestration 加载文档，再执行；完整接管或终端操作则交给 orca-cli。
howto.when: 当任务需要结构化多智能体协调（如任务分发、搭建任务 DAG、处理多智能体决策门等）时触发；若只是完整移交控制权或普通终端命令，则转向 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 帮我协调两个子智能体：一个写代码，一个写测试，最后合并结果。
say.note: 进入多智能体任务编排流程

say.text: 把任务拆成 DAG，让 B 等 A 完成后才开始。
say.note: 触发任务 DAG 与依赖编排

say.text: 让多个智能体分头调研，等全部汇报后我再决定。
say.note: 进入 worker_done 等待与决策门

howto.what_en: Makes Claude use Orca orchestration for multi-agent coordination: it resolves the CLI, loads the guide via `orca skills get orchestration`, then runs commands; full handoffs and terminal control go to orca-cli.
howto.when_en: Triggers when structured multi-agent coordination is needed, such as task dispatch, task DAGs, or coordinator loops; full handoffs and ordinary terminal commands are handled by orca-cli instead.

say_en.text: Have two sub-agents work in parallel: one codes, one tests, then merge.
Break the task into a DAG and let B start only after A finishes.
say_en.note: Triggers task DAG and dependency orchestration.

say_en.text: Have agents research separately; I'll decide after all report back.
say_en.note: Enters worker_done wait and decision gate.
